description: The c₀↔NZ-torsion factor on the Borromean rings is 2^(c−1), not a framing artifact: all 2^c peripheral framings give |det|≥64 (min=64, all-meridian), none 16. Audit-only; no fit; nothing wired.

data.note: meridian framing 64 is the unique minimum; no framing yields 16, so the factor 4 is the reduced-Habiro-vs-Kashaev normalization 2^(c-1), not a framing choice. Whitehead (c=2 -> factor 2) is the decisive confirmation; the per-cusp-2 mechanism is the multi-cusp saddle Gaussian, recorded not proved.
